column_description: Unique identifier for each educational region.
Name of the educational region. may be NULL.
Type of region (e.g., urban, rural, suburban). always exactly one of 'urban', 'rural', 'suburban'. may be NULL.
Population of the region. may be NULL.
Number of schools in the region. may be NULL.
Name of the contact person for the region. may be NULL.
Email of the contact person for the region. may be NULL.
